title: 第11章 上官无情想弄死老夫你够格吗第12章 纠结的柳紫嫣好消息与坏消息
content_zh:
随即，赵东海大手一挥。
几名杂役弟子一拥而上，将林陌五花大绑了起来。
“还在这跟我装？嗯？”
赵东海注意到了林陌那双微微颤抖的瞳孔，冷笑道：“害怕了？吓老子一跳，搞得刚才我还以为，你真不怕死呢。”
说话之余，赵东海的手中，不知何时出现了一个玉瓶。
玉瓶中，装着一枚通体漆黑的丹药。
赵东海稍微摇晃了一下玉瓶，不紧不慢地道：“认识这是什么丹药吗？不认识不要紧，听我慢慢给你介绍一下。”
“这是一枚死气丹，顾名思义，只要服下一枚，它会疯狂吸收人体的生气，最后只剩下一具腐朽的躯壳。”
“我想...明天吕管事就可以对外宣布，杂役部林陌于昨晚在睡梦中寿终正寝，然后光明正大地处理你的尸体。”
“相信我，不会有人来调查的。”
看着赵东海手中的死气丹，林陌那被束缚的干枯手掌，紧紧地握在了一起。
心跳也随之加速。
“柳紫嫣那女魔头真不管老夫了？”
一抹冷汗，自林陌额头滴落。
你要么就不管，要么能不能效率一点啊！
执法堂的人再不来，他恐怕真要毁在吕明通和赵东海手里了！
“这执法堂的人，怎么也有这种拖延的毛病？”
内心虽然慌得一批，但林陌表面依旧稳如老狗。
今天他哪怕是死，也要死得优雅。
“赵主管，依老夫看，没搞清楚自身处境的人，应该是你们。”

踏踏踏！
就在这时，屋外忽然传来了一阵急促的、不同寻常的脚步声。
林陌顿时大喜，那颗悬着的心，总算是放了下来。
而后大笑出声：“哈哈哈！
老夫还是刚才那句话，这是你们最后的狂欢，但也到此为止了。”
赵东海嘴巴微张，刚要说点什么。
却被吕明通伸手打断，因为他也注意到了屋外那一阵阵牵动着他心跳的脚步声。
一股不安的预感，涌上心头。
“去看看外面怎么回事！”
“是，吕管事！”
“还看？收你来了。”
两名杂役还没走到门口，房门便被暴力地踹开，一群身穿统一服饰、手持长枪与刀剑的执法者鱼贯而入。
将本就不大的房间围了个水泄不通。
吕明通、赵东海顿时吓得双腿一软。
他们转身，只见站在众多执法者中间的，是一名精明干练、英姿飒爽，身材又不失丰满的仙子。
仙子双手背负，如鹰般锐利的双眸，正直勾勾地盯着他们。
“无...无情队长？！”
当看清楚来者之时，吕明通瞳孔陡然紧缩，心肺骤停！
上官无情，执法堂朱雀分队队长。
执法堂四支分队队长，要说最不愿意落入其手中的人，当属朱雀分队队长上官无情莫属。

至于为什么，吕明通并不清楚。
只是宗门内一直流传着这么一个传说，但凡被上官无情抓去之人，就没有能够活着回来的。
“无情队长，我...我们犯了什么事了？！”
content_en:
Immediately, Zhao Donghai waved his hand.
Several handyman disciples swarmed forward and tied up Lin Mo Wuhuada.
"Still pretending to be with me here? Huh?"
Zhao Donghai noticed Lin Mo's slightly trembling pupils and sneered: "Are you scared? It scared me. Just now I thought you were really not afraid of death."
While talking, a jade bottle appeared in Zhao Donghai's hand.
In the jade bottle, there is a dark elixir.
Zhao Donghai shook the jade bottle a little and said calmly: "Do you know what kind of elixir this is? It doesn't matter if you don't. Let me introduce it to you slowly."
"This is a death energy pill. As the name suggests, as long as you take one, it will absorb the vitality of the human body crazily, leaving only a decaying body in the end."
"I think... Manager Lu can announce to the public tomorrow that Lin Mo from the Ministry of Civil Service died in his sleep last night, and then dispose of your body in a fair and just way."
"Trust me, no one will investigate."
Looking at the Death Qi Pill in Zhao Donghai's hand, Lin Mo's restrained withered hands clenched tightly.
The heartbeat also accelerated.
"That female devil Liu Ziyan really doesn't care about me anymore?"
A wisp of cold sweat dripped from Lin Mo's forehead.
Either you don't care, or you can be more efficient!
If the people from the Law Enforcement Hall don't come, I'm afraid he will really be destroyed in the hands of Lu Mingtong and Zhao Donghai!
"Why do the people in the Law Enforcement Hall have such a problem with procrastination?"
Although he was panicking inside, Lin Mo remained as calm as an old dog on the outside.
Even if he dies today, he must die gracefully.
"Director Zhao, in my opinion, you should be the ones who don't understand your situation."
Tap tap tap!
At this moment, there was a burst of rapid and unusual footsteps outside the house.
Lin Mo was immediately overjoyed, and his anxious heart was finally relieved.
Then he laughed out loud: "Hahaha!
I still said what I just said, this is your last carnival, but it ends here. "
Zhao Donghai opened his mouth slightly and was about to say something.
But he was interrupted by Lu Mingtong's hand, because he also noticed the footsteps outside the house that affected his heartbeat.
An uneasy premonition came to my mind.
"Go and see what's going on outside!"
"Yes, Manager Lu!"
"You still want to read? I've got you here."
Before the two handymen could reach the door, the door was violently kicked open, and a group of law enforcers wearing uniforms and holding spears and swords filed in.
The already small room was filled with water.
Lu Mingtong and Zhao Donghai were so frightened that their legs weakened.
They turned around and saw standing among the many law enforcers, a shrewd, capable, heroic and plump fairy.
The fairy put her hands behind her back and stared at them with sharp eyes like an eagle.
"No...Captain Ruthless?!"
When he saw clearly who was coming, Lu Mingtong's pupils suddenly contracted and he went into cardiopulmonary arrest!
Shangguan Wu is ruthless and the captain of the Suzaku detachment of the Law Enforcement Hall.
Among the four captains of the Law Enforcement Hall, the person least willing to fall into his hands is none other than the captain of the Suzaku Squadron, Shangguan Qingqing.
As for why, Lu Mingtong didn't know.
It's just that there is a legend that has been circulating in the sect that no one who is ruthlessly captured by Shangguan can come back alive.
"Captain Ruthless, I...what did we do?!"
